title: Italien 2242 — Lucinge, 1588
contents: Lucinge discusses the king’s concessions, Rouen’s reception of the king, the Paris factions and the risks of civil war. Later letters concern Corbeil, Melun, marriage plans and the princess of Condé.
status: 7/30 pages transcribed; 1 more in part; 7/30 pages deciphered; 1 more in part
